fundamental_truths: The Veil is a living entity that erases memories and reshapes reality
Thornreach Grove is the last sanctuary of the old gods, protected by fading wards
Memory is a resource that can be traded for power or survival
The Withered Court, a lost royal bloodline, rules from inside The Veil
Mystic relics scattered throughout the realm reveal fragments of the world's lost past
The old gods' power is tied to the natural cycles of the forest
The Veil's corruption spreads faster during the waning moon
Ancient prophecies speak of a 'Memory Weaver' who can control The Veil
The forest's heart beats in rhythm with the protective wards
Time flows differently within The Veil's embrace

worldbuilding.setting: A mystical forest realm on the brink of being consumed by The Veil

magic_system.druidic_magic: Nature-based magic that draws power from the forest's life force
magic_system.fae_enchantments: Ancient magic of the fae, tied to the realm's natural cycles
magic_system.veil_magic: Forbidden arts that manipulate The Veil's power
magic_system.memory_magic: Rare ability to manipulate and preserve memories
magic_system.ward_magic: Protective magic passed down from the old gods

political_system.withered_court: Corrupted rulers who maintain their power through The Veil
political_system.druid_circle: Guardians of Thornreach Grove's ancient traditions
political_system.memory_keepers: Secret society preserving the realm's history
political_system.fae_courts: Ancient powers maintaining neutrality in the conflict
political_system.refugee_camps: Scattered settlements of those who escaped The Veil

major_locations.thornreach_grove: The last untouched sanctuary, protected by ancient wards
major_locations.the_veil: A sentient fog that consumes and transforms everything it touches
major_locations.withered_court: The corrupted seat of power within The Veil
major_locations.mystic_ruins: Scattered remnants of the old world containing powerful relics
major_locations.memory_pools: Sacred springs where memories crystallize into physical form
major_locations.fae_crossroads: Ancient meeting place of the fae courts
major_locations.warden's_watch: High vantage point where the druids monitor The Veil's spread
major_locations.forgotten_archive: Library of preserved memories and ancient knowledge
major_locations.heartwood_sanctuary: The oldest tree in Thornreach, source of the wards' power
major_locations.twilight_market: Trading post where memories are bartered for supplies
